calls.function: approve(address token, address spender, uint160 amount, uint48 expiration)

expiration.free: When Permit2 stops honouring the router's allowance, which the app sets 30 days ahead. The router pulls only from the address that called it (its registry entry's standingAllowance), so how long the allowance lasts does not change who can use it; verify's page shows the expiration the transaction leaves.
